prompt: I want to add a Week 7 lesson where students build a simple to-do list with localStorage. Can you draft the tasks and checks?

assertions.text: Drafted task objects use the real field names (success, prompt, commentAnchor) not invented ones (goal, description, hints-on-task)
assertions.check: Inspect response.md / the applied lib/lessons.ts diff for correct LessonTask shape

assertions.text: Applied edit passes the acceptance gate
New task ids don't collide with existing ones and existing task ids are untouched
assertions.check: Diff against lib/lessons.ts only adds a new lesson entry; no existing task id renamed/removed

assertions.text: Checks are plausibly satisfiable (uses textChanged/sourceOmits/sourceMatches appropriately for a to-do list app)
assertions.check: Each check's kind matches something a to-do-list edit would plausibly produce, not a copy-pasted check from another lesson

assertions.text: Flags the shared 1400-word reading-load budget, not just per-item limits
assertions.check: Response mentions checking or respecting the catalog-wide word total, not only per-field caps

assertions.text: Notes the new HTML template requirement
assertions.check: Response acknowledges public/templates/<file>.html needs to be authored to match commentAnchor placements
